subject.title: [Feature]: Add global --dry-run mode to prevent all tool calls from executing

question: Should OpenClaw add a global agent dry-run mode, and what exact side-effect boundary should it guarantee across Gateway, embedded, plugin, client, and deferred tool execution paths?
rationale: The request is useful and aligned with safe defaults, but a misleading partial dry-run would create a new operator trust boundary around side effects.

options.title: Design the contract first
options.body: Specify the dry-run semantics across all tool execution funnels, then implement the CLI flag and tests against that shared contract.

options.title: Accept a CLI-only preview
options.body: Limit the first implementation to `openclaw agent --local` or CLI Gateway dispatch and document the uncovered paths clearly.

options.title: Defer to existing controls
options.body: Close or defer the feature and direct users to tool policy, sandboxing, approvals, and plugin hooks instead of a global preview mode.

recommendation.title: Design the contract first
recommendation.body: Specify the dry-run semantics across all tool execution funnels, then implement the CLI flag and tests against that shared contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the broadest recent history across the agent runtime, tool adapter, and gateway tool invocation surfaces involved in this security contract.
